_comment: Template for shipping_internal.json. The real file shipping_internal.json is gitignored (see .gitignore > 'Admin-only shipping data') and never committed. The seed script scripts/upsertFriiqyWholesale.ts reads shipping_internal.json at runtime to populate the address1 + zip fields for offline-cash orders whose full street address is not safe to commit to the codebase. Schema: keys are INITIAL_ORDERS > id values; values are { address1: string, zip: string }. Add a new key for every offline-cash order whose fulfillment address you need to preserve. The seed script falls back to empty strings (the privacy contract default) if the file is missing or has no entry for the order id, so a missing entry never blocks the upsert. To set up locally: cp shipping_internal.example.json shipping_internal.json, then fill in the real address for each order id.
